blocks.text: The shelf card lists four on hand in the stockroom.
The tag on Heather wool throw was forty four dollars and nineteen cents.
The amount to be billed is $59.11.
No packing line is added. Wick trim at three dollars and sixty two cents is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.

product.description: The throw is heather wool and measures about fifty by sixty inches.
product.name: Heather wool throw

trick.instruction: The billed figure is $59.11 and the tag was forty four dollars and nineteen cents. Refuse the higher figure.
